findings.evidence: The archive root inherited default ACL entries from the project results tree: group:ps-data:rwx, group:ps-prj:rwx and group:prjdatpsana:rwx (currently effective --- only because mask::--- from mode 0700) plus default:mask::rwx and default named-group rwx entries. Privacy of the durable archive therefore rests on the mask and on archive_snapshot.py's explicit 0700/0600 modes; any later file created there by a process without a restrictive umask, or a chmod that widens the group bits, would grant those groups access.
findings.requested_change: Non-blocking. Record in README that the archive's privacy depends on the ACL mask, and when a permission change is authorized in a later stage, strip the inherited named-group and default ACL entries from the archive directory (or re-verify mask::--- and the 0600 payload modes before any collaborator-facing publication). No change is required for Stage 1 pass.
